manifest.name: dsh-vram-switcher
manifest.description: Native DSH Cordis plugin + AstrBot adapter for local AI companions: coordinate LLM, IndexTTS and ComfyUI on one GPU.

bundle.text:
# Native DSH Cordis plugin. The package's dsh.bundle.patch points here.
# Override this id in the profile patch to fill in profilePath / dataDir / pythonPath.

- insert:
    - id: vram-switcher
      name: './dsh-plugin/index.js'
      config:
        enabled: true
        profilePath: ''
        dataDir: ''
        pythonPath: ''
        leaseSeconds: 900

declared.name: vram_status
declared.description: Show the local GPU coordinator status for this machine. Use before deciding whether to acquire the GPU for a local ComfyUI/image or TTS task.

declared.name: vram_acquire
declared.description: Acquire the GPU coordinator lease before a local ComfyUI/image or TTS job. May stop the local LLM and start the requested service; the lease is held until release or timeout.

declared.name: vram_release
declared.description: Release a vram_acquire lease, stop leftover image/TTS services as configured, and restore the local LLM.

readme.text:
**[English](README.en.md)** · [Releases](https://github.com/xiaoxiao150/vram-switcher/releases) · [IndexTTS 集成](docs/indextts.md) · [GPU 兼容性](docs/gpu-support.md) · [和 llama-swap / berth 的区别](docs/comparison.md)

**为本地 AI 情感陪伴（AstrBot / DeepSeek Harness）原生接入的 GPU 调度器 —— 让人设对话、IndexTTS 语音和自拍/改图在同一张 12 GB 卡上轮流用卡。**

它不是通用 GPU 租约系统：不换客户端、不加代理、不读 `nvidia-smi`，只在宿主的事件边界上停/起你明确列出的进程。

在 12 GB 卡上，它把本地 LLM、IndexTTS 和 ComfyUI 从「互相换页」变成「轮流独占」——实测 `s2mel` 从 **30 s/步回到 0.12 s/步**，预填从 **0.2 tok/s 回到 ~1300 tok/s**。

```text
LLM 常驻，显存 4.9 GB / 12 GB
        │
        ├── "/aimg 一只猫" ──► 停 LLM ──► 起 ComfyUI ──► 出图 ──► 等队列跑空
        │                              (腾出 ~6 GB)             停 ComfyUI

它只负责这些「停/起」的**顺序**。不是模型、不是路由、也不是要你重写的启动器：所有机器相关的参数都在一个 JSON profile 里。

12 GB 卡上通常是这样：

| 服务 | 常驻显存 |
|---|---|
| `llama-server`（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE，256K 上下文） | ~4.9 GB |
| IndexTTS webui | ~2.3–5.3 GB |
| ComfyUI + SD/Flux | ~6–7 GB |
| 桌面 + 宿主程序 | ~2 GB |

前三个里任意两个加桌面就会溢出。Windows 不会当场报错，而是开始把显存换页到内存——**这不会崩，只会慢 100 倍**。在写下它的那台机器上实测：`s2mel` 扩散从 **0.12 s/步 变成 30 s/步**，一张图跑了 **543 秒**，预填从 ~1300 tok/s 掉到 **0.2 tok/s**。进程一直是活的。

这套东西最初就是给一个本地 AI 陪伴机器人写的：她要有人设连续性（本地 LLM）、要能发语音（IndexTTS）、要能自拍和改图（ComfyUI），而且这些经常发生在同一个回合里。通用 GPU 调度器不知道一段语音什么时候真正合成完；对陪伴场景，那个边界恰恰是最重要的。
解法不是换更大的卡，而是确保关键时刻只有一个在占显存。

- 任务前**停掉不需要的**、**拉起需要的**，结束后再放回去。
- **真的等就绪**：ComfyUI 必须 8188 在 listen，而不是进程刚起（早 1 秒连接曾让每次自拍都失败）；一批图会先等 `/queue` 跑空再停服务。
- **只动你列出的东西**：进程名 + 命令行过滤 + 可选端口白名单，没有“杀掉所有 python.exe”这条路。
- **跨进程串行**：AstrBot 插件和 DSH 插件共用 `coordinator.lock`，语音事件和生图任务不会同时切服务。
- **一套核心，两个宿主**：AstrBot（Python 插件）与 DeepSeek Harness（原生 Cordis 插件 + 小 Python daemon）。另带 MCP stdio 服务，可给 Claude Desktop / Codex 用。
- **可复现的实测记录**：[docs/demo.md](docs/demo.md) 有语音和生图两条交接时序，以及换页前后的数字。

显存协调已经不缺项目：[llama-swap](https://github.com/mostlygeek/llama-swap) 6.1k★，[berth](https://github.com/T-Crypt/berth) 2026-10-11 才公开、已 200★，vhotseat、OneGPU4All 也在做类似的事。这个项目不假装是通用调度器，它只解决一个具体问题：

> **你在 AstrBot 或 DSH 上跑一个本地 AI 陪伴：人设对话（本地 LLM）+ IndexTTS 语音 + 自拍/改图（ComfyUI），全在同一张 12 GB 卡上。**

一次回合里可能同时发生：

```text
用户消息
  ├─ 她回复文字（LLM 占卡）
  ├─ 回复带 [语音] → 停 LLM → IndexTTS 合成 → 恢复 LLM
  └─ 调 generate_selfie → 停 LLM/TTS → ComfyUI 出图 → 恢复 LLM

| 你的情况 | 更合适的选择 |
|---|---|
| 只是 llama.cpp / vLLM 换模型，所有客户端都能改 base URL | [llama-swap](https://github.com/mostlygeek/llama-swap) |
| 要通用 GPU 租约、优先级、游戏/VM/多卡仲裁 | [berth](https://github.com/T-Crypt/berth)（alpha，Windows 实验性） |
| Linux 上 LLM ↔ ComfyUI 轮流 | [vhotseat](https://github.com/wandermyz/vhotseat) |
| **在 AstrBot / DSH 上跑本地 AI 陪伴，不想改端口、不加代理，语音合成结束才切** | **本项目** |

相对通用调度器，它**多做**这些：

- AstrBot 的 5 个事件钩子：LLM 请求、回复装饰前后、工具调用前、工具返回后
- DSH 原生 Cordis 工具：`vram_status` / `vram_acquire` / `vram_release`
- IndexTTS 的 `tts_busy.flag` / `tts_ready.flag` 协议（合成边界，不是 HTTP 边界）
- 真实进程停启：TTS 没有 unload API 也能让出显存

也**少做**这些：多卡、游戏/VM、优先级队列、网关、`nvidia-smi` 轮询、provider 自动切换。需要这些就选上面的通用项目。

不跑 AstrBot / DSH 也可以：核心包 `vram_switcher` 不依赖宿主，`VramService` 提供 `start / acquire / release / status`，可以直接在你的 AI 陪伴服务里用：

```python
from vram_switcher import load_config
from vram_switcher.service import VramService

cfg = load_config({"profile_path": "profile.local.json"}, plugin_dir=".", data_dir="./data")
service = VramService(cfg)
await service.start()
await service.acquire("image", reason="selfie")   # 停 LLM、起 ComfyUI

await service.release("selfie")                   # 停 ComfyUI、恢复 LLM
```

语音侧仍建议走 `tts_busy.flag` / `tts_ready.flag`，因为只有 TTS 插件知道合成什么时候真正结束。

调度器本身不挑卡：没有 CUDA / ROCm / `nvidia-smi` 依赖，只看进程、命令行、端口和 flag。挑卡的是它调度的三个服务。

| 组件 | N 卡 Windows | A 卡 Windows | A 卡 Linux |
|---|---|---|---|
| 调度器 | ✅ 生产验证 | ⚠️ 机制可用，未实测 | ⚠️ 基础支持 |
| llama.cpp | ✅ CUDA | ⚠️ Vulkan（社区常用） | ⚠️ ROCm / Vulkan |
| ComfyUI | ✅ CUDA | ⚠️ DirectML / ZLUDA | ⚠️ ROCm |
| IndexTTS | ✅ CUDA | ⚠️ 最易卡住 | ⚠️ ROCm 需实测 |

一句话：**N 卡是已验证路径；A 卡的调度层可用，但 IndexTTS 在 Windows A 卡上最容易卡住**（PyTorch 的 ROCm 轮子覆盖有限）。llama.cpp 用 Vulkan 基本没问题；ComfyUI 走 DirectML/ZLUDA 能跑，但有节点兼容性和性能代价。
A 卡 profile 的关键调整：`ready.type` 用 `port`、超时给足、`recovery_wait_seconds` 加大、`process_names` / `cmdline_any` 按实际构建改。完整矩阵、逐组件说明和检查清单见 [`docs/gpu-support.md`](docs/gpu-support.md)。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xiaoxiao150/vram-switcher
cd vram-switcher

readme.section: 这一步不会启动或停止任何进程。
readme.text:
python configure.py --root D:/AI        # 只看不写加 --dry-run
```

`configure.py` 会写出 `profile.local.json`，并打印它找到了什么：

```text
[detected] llm: running process
[detected] tts: running process
[missing ] image: fill this in by hand
[port    ] 8080 (llm) listening
[port    ] 7860 (tts) listening
[port    ] 8188 (image) free
```

把宿主指向这个文件并重启即可。没探测到的服务会写成 `enabled: false`，插件仍然合法，只是少做一件事。

```text
LLM 常驻
  ├─ TTS 请求 → 停 LLM（可停辅助服务）→ 确保 TTS 在线 → 完成后恢复 LLM
  └─ 生图请求 → 停 LLM（可停 TTS/辅助服务）→ 启动图像服务 → 等就绪
       → 出图完成 → 等队列跑空 → 停图像服务 → 恢复 LLM

- 配置驱动：路径、端口、进程名、启动命令、日志、超时全部在 `profile.local.json`
- 三类服务：`llm` / `tts` / `image`，外加任意数量的只停不启 `aux_services`
- 引擎 / 版本 profile：多个 LLM 引擎（如 `moe`、`dense27b`）、多个 TTS 版本（`2.5` / `2.0`，支持 `auto`）
- TTS 文件协议：`tts_busy.flag` 表示合成中，`tts_ready.flag` 表示显存已就绪
- 为 AI 陪伴回合设计：文字回复 → 语音合成 → 自拍/改图可以在同一回合内安全切换
- 生图队列：恢复前轮询 ComfyUI `/queue`，不打断一批多张图
- 夜间静默：默认 23:00–07:00 不重新拉起本地 LLM，也不启动 TTS/IndexTTS（已在跑的合成可以结束，结束后看门狗再停 webui）
- 兼容层：`_prepare_switch`、`_recover_after_tts`、事件标记、flag 路径全部保留
- 默认不切 provider：交给 AstrBot 的 fallback 链，避免与 `default_provider_id` 打架
- 原生 DSH Cordis 插件 + MCP 备用入口 + 跨进程协调锁

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xiaoxiao150/vram-switcher   AstrBot/data/plugins/astrbot_plugin_vram_switcher
```

也可以直接从插件市场安装：搜 **VRAM Switcher**（[cloud.astrbot.app](https://cloud.astrbot.app/)）。

然后在插件配置里确认：

- `profile_path` = 你生成的 `profile.local.json`（建议放
  `AstrBot/data/plugin_data/astrbot_plugin_vram_switcher/`，填绝对路径）
- `local_llm_engine` = profile 里的引擎键（用 `configure.py` 生成时是 `detected`）
- `index_tts_version` = `auto` 或 `2.5` / `2.0`

没跑过 `configure.py` 的话，也可以从 `profile.example.json` 手动复制一份改。
如果 profile 找不到或 JSON 非法，插件会记录错误并保持禁用，不会崩溃或乱杀进程。

readme.section: IndexTTS 集成：为什么必须停进程
readme.text:
IndexTTS webui 没有“卸载模型”的 HTTP API。它常驻时占 2.3–5.3 GB；本地 LLM 占 4.9 GB；ComfyUI 出图要 6–7 GB。12 GB 卡上三者不能共存，只能让 TTS 在合成前把卡让出来，合成后再还回去。

这里用的是**进程级互斥 + 两个文件**：

```text
AstrBot 决定发语音
  │
  ├─ TTS 插件写 tts_busy.flag（并删掉上一轮的 tts_ready.flag）
  │

关键点：

readme.section: IndexTTS 集成：为什么必须停进程
readme.text:
- `tts_ready.flag` 必须在**真正停完 LLM 之后**写。TTS 抢跑会让 `s2mel` 权重被 Windows 换页：实测 `0.12 s/步 → 30 s/步`，25 步要 731 秒。
- 电话场景下 busy flag 每 1.5 秒续一次，避免被看门狗当成崩溃残留。
- 900 秒没更新的 busy flag 会被清理，防止进程崩了以后永远卡在“合成中”。
- `version_selector: auto` 跟随正在运行的 2.5 / 2.0；两个都没起时用 `default_version`。
- IndexTTS 冷启动约 60 秒，TTS 侧等待 ready 的超时要给够（生产用 150 秒）。

最小 profile：

```json
{
  "services": {
    "tts": {
      "enabled": true,

readme.section: IndexTTS 集成：为什么必须停进程
readme.text: 完整的适配器代码、AstrBot 钩子优先级和失败排查见 [`docs/indextts.md`](docs/indextts.md)。**注意**：这个仓库只提供调度侧；你的 TTS 插件必须按上面的协议写/删 flag，否则联动不会生效。

完整示例见 [`profile.example.json`](profile.example.json)。

profile 字符串里支持两个内置变量，避免把绝对路径写死：

- `${PLUGIN_DIR}`：插件源码目录
- `${DATA_DIR}`：AstrBot 的 `plugin_data/astrbot_plugin_vram_switcher` 目录
- `${ENV_NAME}`：读取同名环境变量

```json
{
  "triggers": {
    "tts_keywords": ["语音"],
    "image_prefixes": ["aimg", "img2img", "改图", "/改图"],

- `tts_keywords`：用户消息包含关键词 → TTS 预切换。
- `image_prefixes`：消息首词匹配 → 生图预切换。
- `image_tool_names`：LLM 决定调用这些工具前 → 生图预切换。
- `tts_reply_marker_pattern`：LLM 回复里出现语音标记 → TTS 预切换。

AstrBot 插件配置里的 `extra_tts_keywords` / `extra_comfyui_prefixes` 会追加到 profile 对应列表。

readme.section: 与其它 AstrBot 插件兼容
readme.text:
- 事件 extra：`_vram_switcher_active`、`_vram_switcher_reason`、`_vram_switcher_indextts_killed`
- `await plugin._prepare_switch(event, "tool:...")`
- `await plugin._recover_after_tts()`
- `on_decorating_result(event)`（也会把最终恢复跑完）
- 模块级兼容函数（`qq_voice_adapter` 的看门狗使用）：
  `_is_indextts_running`、`_kill_indextts_webui`、`_start_indextts_webui`、
  `_is_comfyui_running`、`_is_comfyui_process_running`、`_is_tts_busy`
- 夜间静默时，`_kill_indextts_webui()` 在 `tts_busy.flag` 有效期间会跳过，
  避免把正在合成的语音拦腰杀掉；合成结束后下一轮看门狗再停
- flag 路径可通过 profile 配置；默认仍建议放在 `plugin_data/astrbot_plugin_vram_switcher/`

readme.section: 与其它 AstrBot 插件兼容
readme.text: 如果其它插件硬编码了 flag 路径，保持 `busy_flag` / `ready_flag` 指向同一位置即可。

readme.section: DSH 原生 Cordis 插件
readme.text:
这个仓库同时就是一个原生 DSH 插件包（`dsh-vram-switcher`）：

```text
DSH Cordis -> dsh-plugin/index.js -> ctx.tools.register(...)
                              └─ Python daemon.py -> vram_switcher.Orchestrator
```

- `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向仓库根的 `cordis.patch.yml`
- `dsh-plugin.json` 是 DSH manifest v0.15
- 原生工具：`vram_status` / `vram_acquire` / `vram_release`
- DSH 加载时启动一个长驻 Python daemon，复用 AstrBot 的同一套核心和锁

readme.section: DSH 原生 Cordis 插件
readme.text:
安装与市场发布说明见 [`dsh/README.md`](dsh/README.md)，配置覆盖模板见
[`dsh/cordis.patch.example.yml`](dsh/cordis.patch.example.yml)。DSH 和 AstrBot
必须使用同一个 `profile.local.json` 与 `dataDir`，否则跨进程锁不会生效。

如果当前 DSH 轮次正在使用本地 LLM，不要调用 `vram_acquire`，否则它会停掉正在
生成回复的模型。

MCP 仍作为备用入口保留：`mcp_server.py` 可给 Claude Desktop、Codex 等没有原生
Cordis 插件的宿主使用；不要和原生插件同时加载，避免重复管理同一组服务。

核心包 `vram_switcher/` 不依赖 AstrBot，可以直接测试：

```bash
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

测试使用 FakeSystem，不会启动/停止真实进程，也不需要 GPU；`tests/test_configure.py` 会验证 `configure.py --dry-run` 只输出 JSON、拒绝覆盖已有文件，并确认生成的 profile 能被真实 loader 接受。

CI 见 [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml)，在 Python 3.10 / 3.11 / 3.12 上跑单元测试。

**本仓库是开发副本。** 不要在 AstrBot 的
`data/plugins/astrbot_plugin_vram_switcher/` 里直接编辑或提交；生产目录只由
`scripts/deploy.py` 覆盖，并且不再包含 `.git`。改完、跑完测试再部署：

```bash
python scripts/deploy.py --dry-run
python scripts/deploy.py
```

部署后按单个 PID 重启 AstrBot（不要 `/T` 树杀）。这样开发中的重构不会直接改坏正在运行的陪伴链路。

- **2026-08**：第一版写在一个本地 AI 陪伴项目里。当时她在 AstrBot 里用本地 LLM 聊天、用 IndexTTS 发语音、用 ComfyUI 自拍，三件事只能手动杀进程轮换，经常把正在生成的回复卡死。
- **2026-09-28**：一次请求在 ComfyUI 冷启动窗口（当时只等 120 秒）误落到云端节点；此后把就绪等待改成 300 秒，并把“停/起”做成显式状态机。
- **2026-10**：重构成 profile 驱动的 2.0，同一套核心接上 AstrBot 插件与 DSH 原生 Cordis 插件，开源。
- **2026-10-26**：公开仓库。代码在公开前已经在一台 12 GB 机器上跑了两个多月。

公开时间不等于开始时间。这段历史写在这里，是因为在“谁先”这个问题上，最早的生产日志比仓库创建日期更有说服力；也是因为这个项目的第一需求从来不是“调度 GPU”，而是“让她在只有一张 12 GB 卡的情况下，仍然能同时聊天、发语音和自拍”。

- Windows 优先；Linux 有基本的 `ps`/`kill` 支持，但进程名和启动器差异需要自行适配。
- NVIDIA 是生产验证路径；A 卡/Intel 的调度层可用，但三个服务的后端支持差异很大，见 [GPU 兼容性](docs/gpu-support.md)。
- 不读取 `nvidia-smi` 显存数值；显存是否释放由进程/端口/标志文件推断。这样更可预测，也避免驱动差异。
- TTS 必须实现 busy/ready 文件协议；其它 TTS 可以自己写一个薄适配器。
- ComfyUI 队列接口默认为 `/queue`；其它图像服务可以在 profile 里改 `queue.url`，或设为不可用。
- 默认不做 provider 切换；需要的话继承 `NullProviderHooks` 并在适配器里实现。

- **AstrBot**：WebUI → 插件市场 搜 **VRAM Switcher**，或
  [cloud.astrbot.app](https://cloud.astrbot.app/) 搜仓库 `xiaoxiao150/vram-switcher`。
- **DSH**：已在 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/xiaoxiao150/vram-switcher/) 收录，DSH 插件市场可搜 **vram-switcher**。目录里的 tarball 当前是 v2.0.4；v2.0.5 的夜间 TTS 守卫要等目录下次更新。
- 源码安装：

```bash
  # AstrBot
  git clone https://github.com/xiaoxiao150/vram-switcher     AstrBot/data/plugins/astrbot_plugin_vram_switcher

# DSH（包名 dsh-vram-switcher）

> 仓库名是 `vram-switcher`，但 AstrBot 会把插件安装到
> `data/plugins/astrbot_plugin_vram_switcher/`（取自 `metadata.yaml` 的 `name`），
> 两者不一致是正常的。

发布信息：[v2.0.5 Release](https://github.com/xiaoxiao150/vram-switcher/releases/tag/v2.0.5)。

| 风险 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 杀错进程 | 进程名 **且** 命令行过滤，可选端口白名单；没有裸名字匹配 |
| 杀到自己 | 排除当前 PID 与父 PID |
| Shell 注入 | `start` 是 argv 数组，`shell=False` 执行 |
| 两个宿主打架 | `coordinator.lock` 覆盖整个 acquire → release 窗口 |
| 配置写错 | 加载时校验；非法 profile 只禁用插件并记录原因，不猜 |
| 路径泄漏 | `profile.local.json` 已 git-ignore；示例里没有真实路径 |

**Native GPU coordination for local AI companions on AstrBot / DeepSeek Harness — persona chat, IndexTTS voice and ComfyUI selfies taking turns on one 12 GB card.**

[中文](README.md) · [Releases](https://github.com/xiaoxiao150/vram-switcher/releases) · [IndexTTS integration](docs/indextts.md) (Chinese) · [GPU support](docs/gpu-support.md) (Chinese) · [vs. llama-swap / berth](docs/comparison.md) (Chinese) · [AstrBot plugin](#astrbot) · [Native DSH plugin](#deepseek-harness-dsh)

```text
LLM resident, 4.9 GB / 12 GB used
        │
        ├── "/aimg a cat" ──► stop LLM ──► start ComfyUI ──► generate ──► drain queue
        │                                    (frees ~6 GB)                stop ComfyUI

VRAM Switcher is a small coordinator that owns the *ordering* of those
start/stop transitions. It is not a model, not a router, and not a launcher you
have to rewrite: everything machine-specific lives in one JSON profile.

A 12 GB card holds roughly:

| Service | VRAM when resident |
|---|---|
| `llama-server` (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE, 256K ctx) | ~4.9 GB |
| IndexTTS webui | ~2.3–5.3 GB |
| ComfyUI + SD/Flux | ~6–7 GB |
| Desktop + host app | ~2 GB |

Any two of the first three plus the desktop overflows. Windows then starts
paging VRAM to system RAM, which does not fail loudly — it just makes everything
100× slower. Measured on the machine this was written for: `s2mel` diffusion
went from **0.12 s/step to 30 s/step**, a single image took **543 s**, and prompt
prefill dropped from ~1300 tok/s to **0.2 tok/s**. The process was alive the
whole time.

The fix is not a bigger GPU. It is making sure only one of them is resident when
it matters.

This was written for a local AI companion: she needs persona continuity (local
LLM), voice replies (IndexTTS), and selfies/edits (ComfyUI), often in the same
turn. A generic GPU broker does not know when a voice clip has actually finished
synthesizing; for a companion that boundary is the whole point.

- **Stops what is not needed** before a task, **starts what is** — then puts it back.
- **Waits properly**: ComfyUI's 8188 must be *listening*, not merely spawned
  (a 1-second-early connection used to kill every selfie); a batch of images is
  drained via `/queue` before the service is stopped.
- **Only touches what you listed**: process name + cmdline filter + optional
  port allow-list. There is no "kill all python.exe" path.
- **Serializes across processes**: the AstrBot plugin and the DSH plugin share
  `coordinator.lock`, so a TTS event and a GPU task never swap services at the
  same instant.
- **Works for two hosts from one core**: AstrBot (Python plugin) and DeepSeek
  Harness (native Cordis plugin + a small Python daemon). An MCP stdio server is
  included for Claude Desktop / Codex and friends.
- **A reproducible log walkthrough**: [docs/demo.md](docs/demo.md) has the voice
  and image handoff timelines with the before/after numbers (Chinese).

GPU arbitration is already crowded: [llama-swap](https://github.com/mostlygeek/llama-swap)
has 6.1k stars, [berth](https://github.com/T-Crypt/berth) reached 200 stars after
its October 11, 2026 debut, and vhotseat / OneGPU4All cover nearby cases. This
project does not pretend to be a general scheduler. It solves one specific
setup:

> **You run a local AI companion on AstrBot or DSH: persona chat (local LLM) +
> IndexTTS voice + ComfyUI selfies, all on one 12 GB card.**

| Your situation | Better fit |
|---|---|
| Only swapping llama.cpp / vLLM models, clients can change `base_url` | [llama-swap](https://github.com/mostlygeek/llama-swap) |
| General GPU leases, priorities, games/VMs/multi-GPU | [berth](https://github.com/T-Crypt/berth) (alpha, Windows experimental) |
| Linux LLM ↔ ComfyUI turn-taking | [vhotseat](https://github.com/wandermyz/vhotseat) |
| **AstrBot / DSH companion stack, no proxy, switch only when TTS really finishes** | **this project** |

What it adds over a generic broker: the five AstrBot event hooks, three native
DSH tools, the IndexTTS `tts_busy.flag` / `tts_ready.flag` protocol, real
process stop/start, and a cross-process lock. What it deliberately does not do:
multi-GPU, games/VMs, priority queues, a gateway, `nvidia-smi` polling, or
automatic provider switching. See the
[detailed comparison](docs/comparison.md) (Chinese).

The coordinator is vendor-agnostic: no CUDA, ROCm or `nvidia-smi` calls. It only
looks at processes, command lines, ports and flag files. The three services are
the part that cares about the card.

| Component | NVIDIA Windows | AMD Windows | AMD Linux |
|---|---|---|---|
| Coordinator | ✅ production-tested | ⚠️ mechanism works, untested | ⚠️ basic support |
| llama.cpp | ✅ CUDA | ⚠️ Vulkan (common) | ⚠️ ROCm / Vulkan |
| ComfyUI | ✅ CUDA | ⚠️ DirectML / ZLUDA | ⚠️ ROCm (more mature) |
| IndexTTS | ✅ CUDA | ⚠️ the hard part | ⚠️ ROCm, needs testing |

NVIDIA Windows is the tested path. AMD works at the orchestration layer, but
**IndexTTS on Windows AMD is the bottleneck** (PyTorch ROCm wheel coverage is
limited). llama.cpp via Vulkan is usually fine; ComfyUI via DirectML or ZLUDA
runs with node-compatibility and performance costs.

For AMD profiles: use `ready.type: "port"`, give longer timeouts, raise
`recovery_wait_seconds`, and adjust `process_names` / `cmdline_any` to the actual
build. Full matrix and checklist: [`docs/gpu-support.md`](docs/gpu-support.md)
(Chinese).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xiaoxiao150/vram-switcher
cd vram-switcher

readme.section: Nothing is started or stopped by this step.
readme.text:
python configure.py --root D:/AI        # add --dry-run to just look
```

`configure.py` writes `profile.local.json` and prints what it found:

```text
[detected] llm: running process
[detected] tts: running process
[missing ] image: fill this in by hand
[port    ] 8080 (llm) listening
[port    ] 7860 (tts) listening
[port    ] 8188 (image) free
```

readme.section: Nothing is started or stopped by this step.
readme.text:
Point the host at that file and restart it. Services it could not detect are
written with `enabled: false` — the plugin stays valid and simply does less.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xiaoxiao150/vram-switcher \
  AstrBot/data/plugins/astrbot_plugin_vram_switcher
```

Or install from the plugin market: search **VRAM Switcher**
([cloud.astrbot.app](https://cloud.astrbot.app/)). Then set `profile_path` in the
plugin settings.

Compatibility hooks used by other AstrBot companion plugins
(`_prepare_switch`, `_recover_after_tts`, `on_decorating_result`,
`_vram_switcher_*` event extras, `tts_busy.flag` / `tts_ready.flag`) are
preserved, so existing setups keep working.

readme.section: IndexTTS: why this stops the process
readme.text:
IndexTTS webui has no "unload model" endpoint. Resident it takes 2.3–5.3 GB; the
local LLM takes 4.9 GB; ComfyUI takes 6–7 GB. On a 12 GB card they cannot
coexist, so the TTS side has to give the card back before synthesis and take it
again afterwards.

The handoff uses two files:

readme.section: IndexTTS: why this stops the process
readme.text:
1. The TTS plugin writes `tts_busy.flag` (and removes a stale `tts_ready.flag`)
   **before** submitting a job.
2. VRAM Switcher stops the LLM, brings the TTS webui online if needed, waits for
   the port to listen, then writes `tts_ready.flag`.
3. The TTS plugin waits for `ready` **and** an open port before submitting.
4. On success or failure the TTS plugin removes `busy` in `finally`; VRAM
   Switcher restores the LLM.

readme.section: IndexTTS: why this stops the process
readme.text:
Do not write `ready` early: if synthesis starts while the LLM still holds VRAM,
Windows pages the `s2mel` weights and a step goes from **0.12 s to 30 s**.
IndexTTS cold start is about 60 s, so allow at least 150 s. A busy flag older
than 900 s is treated as a crash leftover.

readme.section: IndexTTS: why this stops the process
readme.text:
The full adapter, profile, AstrBot hook priorities and troubleshooting are in
[`docs/indextts.md`](docs/indextts.md) (Chinese, with copy-paste code). The
repository provides the scheduler side; your TTS plugin must implement the flag
contract.

The repository is also a native Cordis plugin (`dsh-vram-switcher`): root
`cordis.patch.yml`, `dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json`, manifest v0.15. Tools:

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `vram_status` | current state of each service + active lease |
| `vram_acquire` | take the GPU for `image` or `tts` (may stop the LLM) |
| `vram_release` | give it back: drain, stop, restore the LLM |

Listed in the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/xiaoxiao150/vram-switcher/)
catalog and searchable as **vram-switcher** in the DSH plugin market. The catalog
tarball currently points to v2.0.4; the v2.0.5 night-TTS guard arrives with the
next catalog update.
See [`dsh/README.md`](dsh/README.md) for the profile override and the caveat:
**do not acquire while the same turn is using the local LLM** — it would stop
the model mid-answer.

- `aux_services` are stopped but never started — right for a prompt optimizer
  that re-launches itself on demand.
- `night_quiet` keeps both the local LLM and TTS down overnight (23:00–07:00 by
  default); an already-running synthesis may finish, then the watchdog stops the
  webui. Set `enabled: false` if you want them back immediately.
- `stop_by_port` only when the port is exclusively that service.
- Full reference and every field: [Chinese README](README.md#profile-参考) /
  [`profile.example.json`](profile.example.json).

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Killing the wrong process | name **and** cmdline filters; optional port allow-list; never a bare name match |
| Killing itself | own PID and parent PID excluded |
| Shell injection | `start` takes an argv array, executed with `shell=False` |
| Two hosts fighting | `coordinator.lock` held across the whole acquire → release window |
| Bad config | profile validated on load; invalid profile disables the plugin with a logged reason instead of guessing |
| Leaked paths | `profile.local.json` is git-ignored; the shipped example has no real paths |

```bash
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v     # 36 tests, no GPU, no real processes
```

CI runs on Python 3.10–3.12, validates the DSH manifest against the official
schema, and checks that the published npm tarball contains no caches or tests.

- **2026-08**: the first version was written inside a local AI companion
  project. She chatted through a local LLM, spoke through IndexTTS, and sent
  selfies through ComfyUI; the only way to switch was to kill processes by hand,
  which regularly killed the reply that was being generated.
- **2026-09-28**: a request hit a ComfyUI cold-start window (the wait was 120 s
  at the time) and fell through to a cloud node. The readiness window became
  300 s, and start/stop became an explicit state machine.
- **2026-10**: rewritten as the profile-driven 2.0 core, with native AstrBot and
  DSH adapters, then open-sourced.
- **2026-10-26**: public repository. The code had already been running on one
  12 GB machine for more than two months.

Public date is not start date. This history is here because, for the "who was
first" question, the earliest production log is more convincing than the
repository creation date — and because the first requirement was never "schedule
a GPU"; it was "let her chat, speak and send a selfie on a single 12 GB card".

- Windows first. Linux has basic `ps`/`kill` support but process names differ.
- NVIDIA is the tested path; AMD/Intel orchestration works, but the service backends differ — see [GPU support](docs/gpu-support.md).
- No `nvidia-smi` polling: readiness comes from processes, ports and flag files,
  which is predictable and driver-independent.
- TTS needs the busy/ready flag protocol; other engines need a thin adapter.
- Provider switching is intentionally off by default — it fights AstrBot's
  fallback chain. Subclass `NullProviderHooks` if you want it.
